channel.title: The Nevada Independent - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Nevada Independent (thenevadaindependent.com)

item.title: Former Google CEO's links to secretive company seeking explosive testing near Burning Man
item.description: Further research into BRDR LLC indicate ties to billionaire Eric Schmidt, who served as Google’s CEO from 2001 to 2011 and as the company’s executive chairman until 2017.

item.title: Detenciones de ICE a nativo americanos en otras partes de EE.UU. preocupan a tribus de Nevada
item.description: Como naciones soberanas, se cuestiona la autoridad de ICE para el control migratorio en tierras tribales, que tienen políticas específicas que varían de una tribu a otra.

item.title: Federal OSHA officials OK justification for dismissal of citations issued to Boring Co.
item.description: Independent investigation into the withdrawal of $400K in fines from citations reveals allegations of files being “altered, missing and/or removed” were true.

item.title: Dwayne McClinton, head of Nevada’s energy office, to step down
item.description: Dwayne McClinton, director of the Governor’s Office of Energy, is stepping down after three years in the role, he confirmed to The Nevada Independent Friday morning.

item.title: Qué saber sobre el cierre de Seguridad Nacional de EE.UU, que inicia el fin de semana
item.description: A diferencia del cierre récord de 43 días del otoño pasado, los cierres solo afectarán a agencias que forman parte del Departamento de Seguridad Nacional.

item.title: What to know about the Homeland Security shutdown starting this weekend
item.description: Nevada's two Democratic senators say Republicans have not put forth proposals that sufficiently rein in immigration enforcement agents, and they will not support funding for the Department of Homeland Security as a result.

item.title: Trabajadoras sexuales de burdel de Pahrump se están sindicalizando; argumentan condiciones injustas
item.description: Hace unos días el burdel despidió a tres trabajadoras que impugnaron un nuevo contrato que, según ellas, es injusto. Abogados presentaron orden judicial ante junta laboral federal.

item.title: Partisan past, bipartisan future? April Becker’s first year as Clark County commissioner
item.description: In her first year on the Clark County Commission, the Republican seems to have put aside strong partisan language that defined previous runs for office.

item.title: Trump tax program could grow private schools. Critics fear it could tie Nevada’s hands
item.description: A local public education advocacy group is concerned the program touted by President Donald Trump may not shape up to be as beneficial for the state as proponents think.

item.title: OPINION: As Epstein sleaze spreads, the specter of former Apollo CEO Leon Black reappears
item.description: Given Black’s integral historical position with Apollo, the ease with which the commissioners went along with the carve-out made them look more like facilitators than regulators.
